items.name: Witherbloom, the Balancer
items.oracle_text:
Affinity for creatures (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature you control.)
Flying, deathtouch
Instant and sorcery spells you cast have affinity for creatures.
items.atomic_translated_text: 生物共鸣（你每操控一个生物，此咒语便减少{1}来施放。）\n飞行，死触\n你施放的瞬间和法术咒语具有生物共鸣异能。

items.name: Leonardo, the Balance
items.oracle_text:
Whenever a token you control enters, you may put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Do this only once each turn.
{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Creatures you control gain menace, trample, and lifelink until end of turn.
Partner—Character select (You can have two commanders if both have this ability.)
items.atomic_translated_type: 传奇生物～突变体／忍者／龟
items.atomic_translated_text: 每当一个由你操控的衍生物进场时，你可以在每个由你操控的生物上各放置一个+1/+1指示物。每回合只能如此作一次。\n{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}：直到回合结束，由你操控的生物获得威慑，践踏与系命异能。\n拍档～角色选择（你可将两个具有此异能的生物共同用作指挥官。）

items.name: Hei Bai, Spirit of Balance
items.oracle_text:
Whenever Hei Bai enters or attacks, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. If you do, put two +1/+1 counters on Hei Bai.
When Hei Bai leaves the battlefield, put its counters on target creature you control.
items.flavor_text:
"My friend gave me hope that the forest would grow back."
—Aang
items.atomic_translated_text: 每当黑白进场或攻击时，你可以牺牲另一个生物或神器。若你如此作，则在黑白上放置两个+1/+1指示物。\n当黑白离开战场时，将它的指示物放置在目标由你操控的生物上。
items.atomic_translated_flavor_text: 「我的朋友曾给过我希望，说树林迟早会长回来的。」\n～安昂

items.name: Teval, the Balanced Scale
items.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever Teval attacks, mill three cards. Then you may return a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
items.atomic_translated_text: 飞行\n每当特瓦尔攻击时，磨三张牌。然后你可以将一张地牌从你坟墓场横置移回战场。\n每当一张或数张牌离开你坟墓场时，派出一个2/2黑色灵俑／德鲁伊衍生生物。

items.name: Powerbalance
items.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, you may reveal the top card of your library. If you do, you may cast that card without paying its mana cost if the two spells have the same mana value.
items.flavor_text: For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.
items.zhs_text: 每当任一对手施放咒语时，你可以展示你的牌库顶牌。若你如此作，则如果施放该牌所成之咒语的法术力值与对手咒语的法术力值相同，你可以施放该牌，且不需支付其法术力费用。

items.name: Ambergris, Agent of Balance
items.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Ambergris, Agent of Balance attacks, you may discard your hand and draw two cards. When you do, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
items.atomic_translated_text: 敏捷\n每当平衡密探安珀葛斯特攻击时，你可以弃掉你的手牌并抓两张牌。当你如此作时，在另一个目标由你操控的生物上放置X个+1/+1指示物，X为你本回合中所弃的牌数量。

items.name: Gaea's Balance
items.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice five lands.
Search your library for a land card of each basic land type, put those cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
items.zhs_text: 牺牲五张地，以作为使用盖亚的平衡之额外费用。\n从你的牌库中，每一种基本地类别的地牌各搜寻一张，并将它们放置进场。然后将你的牌库洗牌。
items.atomic_translated_text: 牺牲五个地，以作为施放此咒语的额外费用。\n从你牌库中为每种基本地类别各搜寻一张地牌，将这些牌放进战场，然后洗牌。

items.name: Natural Balance
items.oracle_text: Each player who controls six or more lands chooses five lands they control and sacrifices the rest. Each player who controls four or fewer lands may search their library for up to X basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield, where X is five minus the number of lands they control. Then each player who searched their library this way shuffles.
items.atomic_translated_text: 每位操控六个或更多地的牌手各选择五个由其操控的地，然后牺牲其余的地。每位操控四个或更少地的牌手可以从其牌库中搜寻至多X张基本地牌，并将它们放进战场，X为五减去由其操控的地数量。然后每位以此法搜寻其牌库的牌手洗牌。

items.name: Checks and Balances
items.oracle_text:
Cast this spell only if there are three or more players in the game.
Whenever a player casts a spell, each of that player's opponents may discard a card. If they do, counter that spell.
items.atomic_translated_text: 只能于本盘游戏中有三位或更多牌手时施放此咒语。\n每当任一牌手施放咒语时，每位该牌手的对手各可以弃一张牌。若其如此作，则反击该咒语。
